title: Design: a matrix's menu and its Audit Log
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
  3. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  4. Click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • A menu with one row, Audit Log, opens below the button, as in picture 3.6.

Step 4:

  • A dialog titled "Audit Log:" and matrix A's name opens.
  • It lists "Matrix Created" with "Name: — →" and the name, newest first, with Close, as in picture 3.8.
